content: {"paper_id":"W2108119513","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"nonnegative-matrix-factorization","exact_quote":"In this paper, we propose a novel algorithm, called Graph Regularized Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (GNMF), for this purpose.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文提出并研究以非负矩阵分解为核心、并加入图正则的 GNMF 算法，明确使用非负因子分解。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"In GNMF, an affinity graph is constructed to encode the geometrical information and we seek a matrix factorization, which respects the graph structure.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"通过亲和图编码几何信息，并要求矩阵分解尊重图结构，属于用图结构施加几何一致性约束的图与流形正则化。"},{"keyword_id":"dimensionality-reduction","exact_quote":"One then hopes to find a compact representation,which uncovers the hidden semantics and simultaneously respects the intrinsic geometric structure.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"研究目标是从高维环境空间获得紧凑表示并揭示隐含语义，符合显式低维表示/降维任务。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
